title: What is agent-starter-kit?
text: agent-starter-kit is a minimal, working example of a Claude-powered AI agent, organized so it stays maintainable as tools, memory, and tests are added.

title: How does memory work?
text: Conversation history is grouped into whole turns and trimmed oldest-first once it passes max_turns, so a tool_use/tool_result pair is never split across the trim boundary.

title: How do I add a tool?
text: Create a module under src/tools/ that exports TOOL_DEF and a matching function, then register both in src/tools/__init__.py.
